recommendations.title: Add technical skills to your Skills section
recommendations.description: You can improve your ATS compatibility by adding current technology keywords such as React, Node.js and Docker that are missing from your CV.
recommendations.suggested_text: UI/UX designer focused on interface design and prototyping for mobile applications.

recommendations.title: Back your achievements with numbers
recommendations.description: Adding measurable results such as "Increased sales by 30%" strengthens the impact of your CV.
recommendations.suggested_text: Increased quarterly sales by 30% by redesigning the onboarding flow for 12,000 users.

recommendations.title: Enrich your Education section
recommendations.description: You can raise your education score by adding details such as GPA, thesis project or honors list.
recommendations.suggested_text: B.Sc. in Computer Engineering, GPA 3.6/4.0, Dean's Honor List (2021–2023).

recommendations.title: Add a professional summary
recommendations.description: Strengthen the first impression by adding a 2-3 sentence summary at the top of your CV.

recommendations.title: Standardize date formats
recommendations.description: Write all your dates in "Month Year" format for consistency.
